page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10 percent. However, the 24 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, PassMark, and Geekbench multi-core suites. Memory bandwidth for both read and write operations remains in the average tier, supporting steady data throughput.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the absence of local storage, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallelizable compute workloads that do not require high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. It is suitable for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, batch processing, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It can also handle basic text processing and low-intensity LLM inference, though prompt processing speeds for larger models are limited by the older CPU architecture.
